title: Detailed paint palette
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- background transparent -->
  
  <!-- palette base shape - light wood color -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="42" ry="32" fill="#D4A574"/>
  <!-- lighter wood highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="50" rx="38" ry="28" fill="#E8C49A"/>
  <!-- darker wood edge shadow -->
  <path d="M 12 60 Q 50 88 88 60 Q 50 86 12 60 Z" fill="#C4956A"/>
  
  <!-- thumb hole -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="68" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#8B6B4A"/>
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="67" rx="8" ry="5.5" fill="#B8895E"/>
  
  <!-- palette edge rim highlight -->
  <path d="M 10 50 Q 50 20 90 50" stroke="#F0D5B0" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- paint blobs -->
  
  <!-- red paint -->
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="36" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#E63946"/>
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="34" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="37" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#FF9999" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- orange paint -->
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="44" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#F4A261"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="42" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#FFC285"/>
  <ellipse cx="75" cy="45" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#FFD9A8" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- yellow paint -->
  <ellipse cx="82" cy="58" rx="8" ry="7" fill="#E9C46A"/>
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="56" rx="5.5" ry="4.5" fill="#FFE285"/>
  <ellipse cx="83" cy="59" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#FFF0B3" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- green paint -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="70" rx="8" ry="7" fill="#2A9D8F"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="68" rx="5.5" ry="4.5" fill="#52C5B8"/>
  <ellipse cx="73" cy="71" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#8EE0D5" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- blue paint -->
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="74" rx="8" ry="6.5" fill="#457B9D"/>
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="72" rx="5.5" ry="4" fill="#6BA3C7"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="75" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#9BCFE8" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- purple paint -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="72" rx="8" ry="6.5" fill="#7B2D8E"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="70" rx="5.5" ry="4" fill="#A855C0"/>
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="73" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#D08FE8" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- white paint blob -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="44" rx="7" ry="5.5" fill="#F1FAEE"/>
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="42" rx="4.5" ry="3.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- paint brush handle -->
  <line x1="20" y1="30" x2="38" y2="52" stroke="#8B5E3C" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="30" x2="38" y2="52" stroke="#A6754A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- ferrule (metal band) -->
  <line x1="36" y1="49" x2="41" y2="56" stroke="#B0B0B0" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="36" y1="49" x2="41" y2="56" stroke="#D0D0D0" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- brush bristles -->
  <path d="M 40 55 Q 48 64 52 68 Q 50 62 43 54 Z" fill="#E63946"/>
  <path d="M 41 56 Q 47 63 50 66 Q 48 61 43 55 Z" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
  <path d="M 42 57 Q 46 62 48 64 Q 47 60 43 56 Z" fill="#FF9999"/>
  
  <!-- brush tip paint droplet -->
  <circle cx="52" cy="68" r="2.5" fill="#E63946"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="68" r="1.2" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
  
  <!-- paint drips on palette -->
  <path d="M 66 50 Q 67 54 66 56" stroke="#F4A261" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 78 52 Q 79 55 78 57" stroke="#E9C46A" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- small paint smears -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#E63946" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="60" r="1.5" fill="#2A9D8F" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="60" r="1.5" fill="#457B9D" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- palette slot for brushes -->
  <ellipse cx="18" cy="38" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#8B6B4A"/>
  <ellipse cx="18" cy="37" rx="4" ry="2.2" fill="#B8895E"/>
</svg>
